integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, photorealistic, one continuous unbroken ten-second shot from a camera locked on a tripod at head height. A small harbour front with a stone quay in 1850: gas lamps, mud and cobbles, horse-drawn carts, men in top hats and women in long skirts, a blacksmith's forge smoking. The camera holds a static shot. People go about the day in front of the fixed camera. In the last seconds a time-lapse begins: days and nights flicker past faster and faster. The shot ends as days and nights flicker past faster and faster over a small harbour front with a stone quay.

overall_soundscape: Hooves on cobbles, a hammer on an anvil and street criers.
